complete.explain: When a thing is complete, there is no part of it left to add. It is all there.

confess.explain: To confess is to tell God the wrong you did, out loud, with no part left out.

cross.explain: The cross is two long pieces of wood set one across the other. Men were put to death on one, and Jesus was put to death on one.

darkness.explain: Darkness is what there is when no light is on. In this book it also means that a person does wrong and hides it.

death.explain: Death is when a person stops living and their body is put in the ground.

dye.gloss: to make wool take a dark
dye.explain: To dye wool is to leave it in a pot of dark water until the wool takes the dark on and keeps it.

dyer.explain: A dyer is a person whose work is to dye wool and cloth for other people.

eternal.explain: Something eternal never stops. It has no end at all, not ever.

faithful.explain: A faithful person does what they said they would do, every time, even when it is hard.

fellowship.explain: Fellowship is having your life together with other people who love God, and not being alone.

forgive.explain: To forgive is to stop holding a wrong against the person who did it.

god.gloss: the one who made all things
god.explain: God made everything there is. He is living, He is good, and He has no beginning and no end.

guilt.explain: Guilt is what is true about you when you have done wrong. It stays true until it is forgiven.

jesus.explain: Jesus is God, who came and lived as a man. He was put to death, and then He rose.

joy.explain: Joy is being glad deep down. It can stay even when things are hard, because of what you know.

liar.gloss: one who says what is not true
liar.explain: A liar says what is not true and knows it is not true.

offer.explain: To offer is to hold something out to somebody so they may take it if they want it.

peace.explain: Peace is when the fighting stops. Between you and God it means that nothing stands between you any more.

pray.explain: To pray is to talk to God. You can ask Him for things, thank Him, or tell Him what you did.

raise.explain: To raise a person from death is to make them live again.

religion.gloss: what people do for a god
religion.explain: Religion is all the things people do to please a god - the food they set out, the words they say, the days they keep.

rose.explain: Jesus died, and then He rose. He came back to life and was not dead any more.

sin.explain: Sin is when you do what God says not to do. Every person has sinned.

truth.explain: Truth is what is really so. It stays so if nobody believes it.

weave.explain: To weave is to cross long lines of wool over and under each other until they make cloth.
